verdict.rationale: Importing data when switching tools is a fair question for a work-tracking product like Jira, but the evidence pack documents no first-party import or migration capability. The closest items are rich APIs (a developer building block), ongoing Trello–Jira syncing (an adjacent integration feature rather than a one-time import), and Marketplace apps (third-party extensions). None of these count as Jira's own data-import feature.
